{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CgRu3yWXk3nNmsn7KiTnC","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-Transfer.md ===\n# FEATURE: Transfer\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261027 V1 |\n| Description | Move cash between two accounts as a pair of TRANSFER transactions written atomically. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-LedgerRules.md, FEATURE-Validation.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md, FEATURE-LoadCategories.md |\n| Provides | ledger transfer |\n| Consumes | ledgerlib.rules, ledgerlib.validation, ledgerlib.csvout |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger transfer <from> <to> <amount> <date>` moves cash from one account to another. It stores\ntwo rows in category `TRANSFER` with consecutive ids, or stores neither.\n\n## Trigger\n\nCommand line: `./ledger transfer <from> <to> <amount> <date>`. Implemented in\n`cli/commands/transfer.py` as `run(args) -> list[str]`.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Require exactly four arguments, else `UsageError` (exit 2) before any database access.\n2. Validate both account codes, the amount and the date through `ledgerlib.validation`\n   (exit 3 on violation). The amount must be strictly positive; zero and negative amounts are rejected.\n3. Reject `<from>` equal to `<to>` (exit 3).\n4. Open the ledger. Require both accounts and the category `TRANSFER` to exist (exit 3).\n5. Project the source balance after the outgoing row with `ledgerlib.rules`; a negative result is\n   rejected (exit 3). The destination balance only grows.\n6. In one database transaction, read `next_txn_id`, write the outgoing row with that id, then the\n   incoming row with the next id.\n7. Return the header `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo` and both rows read back from storage.\n\n## Rows Written\n\n| Row | Account | Amount (cents) | Memo |\n|-----|---------|----------------|------|\n| Outgoing, id N | `<from>` | `-amount` | `transfer to <to>` |\n| Incoming, id N+1 | `<to>` | `+amount` | `transfer from <from>` |\n\nBoth rows use category `TRANSFER` and the given date. Amounts are integer cents.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- None — persistence is owned by DATABASE.md.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC transfer-success ===\nIntent: A valid transfer exits 0, prints header plus two rows with consecutive ids, stores both rows, and conserves total cash.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nsrc = \"ZZXFA1\"\ndst = \"ZZXFB1\"\nseed_cat = \"ZZXFSEED\"\ndate = \"2026-06-01\"\namount = \"50.00\"\ncents = int(Decimal(amount) * 100)\nwith db_session() as db:\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    db.categories.create(category=seed_cat, description=\"Xfer seed\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Xfer Source\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Xfer Dest\")\n    seed_id = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=seed_id, date=date, account=src, category=seed_cat, amount=10000, memo=\"seed\")\n    total_before = sum(r.amount for r in db.transactions.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", src, dst, amount, date)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n    assert len(rows) == 3\n    out_row, in_row = rows[1], rows[2]\n    assert int(in_row[0]) == int(out_row[0]) + 1\n    assert out_row[1] == date and in_row[1] == date\n    assert out_row[2] == src and in_row[2] == dst\n    assert out_row[3] == \"TRANSFER\" and in_row[3] == \"TRANSFER\"\n    assert Decimal(out_row[4]) == Decimal(-cents) / 100\n    assert Decimal(in_row[4]) == Decimal(cents) / 100\n    first = db.transactions.get(txn_id=int(out_row[0]))\n    second = db.transactions.get(txn_id=int(in_row[0]))\n    assert first is not None and second is not None\n    assert first.account == src and first.amount == -cents\n    assert second.account == dst and second.amount == cents\n    assert first.category == \"TRANSFER\" and second.category == \"TRANSFER\"\n    assert sum(r.amount for r in db.transactions.list(account=src)) == 10000 - cents\n    assert sum(r.amount for r in db.transactions.list(account=dst)) == cents\n    assert sum(r.amount for r in db.transactions.list()) == total_before\n=== END AC transfer-success ===\n\n=== AC transfer-memo ===\nIntent: The outgoing row memo names the destination and the incoming row memo names the source, as stored and as printed.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nsrc = \"ZZXMA1\"\ndst = \"ZZXMB1\"\nseed_cat = \"ZZXMSEED\"\ndate = \"2026-06-02\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    db.categories.create(category=seed_cat, description=\"Xfer memo seed\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Memo Source\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Memo Dest\")\n    seed_id = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=seed_id, date=date, account=src, category=seed_cat, amount=5000, memo=\"seed\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", src, dst, \"10.00\", date)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[1][5] == f\"transfer to {dst}\"\n    assert rows[2][5] == f\"transfer from {src}\"\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=int(rows[1][0])).memo == rows[1][5]\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=int(rows[2][0])).memo == rows[2][5]\n=== END AC transfer-memo ===\n\n=== AC transfer-rejects-invalid ===\nIntent: Non-positive or malformed amounts, equal accounts, unknown accounts and bad dates exit 3 with empty stdout and store nothing.\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nsrc = \"ZZXRA1\"\ndst = \"ZZXRB1\"\nseed_cat = \"ZZXRSEED\"\ndate = \"2026-06-03\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    db.categories.create(category=seed_cat, description=\"Xfer reject seed\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Reject Source\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Reject Dest\")\n    seed_id = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=seed_id, date=date, account=src, category=seed_cat, amount=100000, memo=\"seed\")\n    cases Version | 20261027 V1 |\n| Description | Guarantee every unknown command, table, report, verb or wrong argument count exits 2 with a usage line on standard error only. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-Init.md, FEATURE-Count.md, FEATURE-LoadTransactions.md, FEATURE-AccountDelete.md, FEATURE-TxnAmend.md, FEATURE-TxnDelete.md, FEATURE-Transfer.md, FEATURE-ReportCategories.md, FEATURE-ReportMonthly.md |\n| Provides | cli.usage |\n| Consumes | ledger, ledger init, ledger count, ledger load accounts, ledger load categories, ledger load transactions, ledger account add, ledger account get, ledger account rename, ledger account delete, ledger txn post, ledger txn get, ledger txn amend, ledger txn delete, ledger transfer, ledger report balances, ledger report categories, ledger report monthly |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nIntegration story proving the usage-error contract across the whole command table.\n\n## Usage Table\n\nOne shared usage table covers every command and sub-verb; a usage error prints that command's\none-line usage text to standard error.\n\n| Command | Usage |\n|---------|-------|\n| `init` | `ledger init` |\n| `count` | `ledger count` |\n| `load` | `ledger load <accounts\\|categories\\|transactions> <csv>` |\n| `account add` / `get` / `rename` / `delete` | `ledger account add <code> <name>`, `get <code>`, `rename <code> <name>`, `delete <code>` |\n| `txn post` / `get` / `amend` / `delete` | `ledger txn post <account> <category> <amount> <date> [<memo>]`, `get <id>`, `amend <id> <amount>`, `delete <id>` |\n| `transfer` | `ledger transfer <from> <to> <amount> <date>` |\n| `report` | `ledger report <balances\\|categories\\|monthly>` |\n\n## Behavior\n\n- `ledger` with no arguments, an unknown command, unknown table, unknown report, unknown verb, or\n  wrong argument count exits 2.\n- Standard output is empty; standard error carries the usage text.\n- Argument-count checks happen before any database access, so a usage error never reads or writes\n  the database.\n- Invalid values of correct arity (for example a non-digit transaction id) are rejections (exit 3),\n  and absent records are not found (exit 4); neither is a usage error.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- None — persistence is owned by DATABASE.md.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC usage-table ===\nIntent: Every unknown command, BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-Transfer.md ===\n# FEATURE: Transfer\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261027 V1 |\n| Description | Move cash between two accounts as a pair of TRANSFER transactions written atomically. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-LedgerRules.md, FEATURE-Validation.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md, FEATURE-LoadCategories.md |\n| Provides | ledger transfer |\n| Consumes | ledgerlib.rules, ledgerlib.validation, ledgerlib.csvout |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger transfer <from> <to> <amount> <date>` moves cash from one account to another. It stores\ntwo rows in category `TRANSFER` with consecutive ids, or stores neither.\n\n## Trigger\n\nCommand line: `./ledger transfer <from> <to> <amount> <date>`. Implemented in\n`cli/commands/transfer.py` as `run(args) -> list[str]`.\n\n## Sequence\n\n1. Require exactly four arguments, else `UsageError` (exit 2) before any database access.\n2. Validate both account codes, the amount and the date through `ledgerlib.validation`\n   (exit 3 on violation). The amount must be strictly positive; zero and negative amounts are rejected.\n3. Reject `<from>` equal to `<to>` (exit 3).\n4. Open the ledger. Require both accounts and the category `TRANSFER` to exist (exit 3).\n5. Project the source balance after the outgoing row with `ledgerlib.rules`; a negative result is\n   rejected (exit 3). The destination balance only grows.\n6. In one database transaction, read `next_txn_id`, write the outgoing row with that id, then the\n   incoming row with the next id.\n7. Return the header `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo` and both rows read back from storage.\n\n## Rows Written\n\n| Row | Account | Amount (cents) | Memo |\n|-----|---------|----------------|------|\n| Outgoing, id N | `<from>` | `-amount` | `transfer to <to>` |\n| Incoming, id N+1 | `<to>` | `+amount` | `transfer from <from>` |\n\nBoth rows use category `TRANSFER` and the given date. Amounts are integer cents.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- None — persistence is owned by DATABASE.md.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC transfer-success ===\nIntent: A valid transfer exits 0, prints header plus two rows with consecutive ids, stores both rows, and conserves total cash.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nsrc = \"ZZXFA1\"\ndst = \"ZZXFB1\"\nseed_cat = \"ZZXFSEED\"\ndate = \"2026-06-01\"\namount = \"50.00\"\ncents = int(Decimal(amount) * 100)\nwith db_session() as db:\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    db.categories.create(category=seed_cat, description=\"Xfer seed\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Xfer Source\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Xfer Dest\")\n    seed_id = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=seed_id, date=date, account=src, category=seed_cat, amount=10000, memo=\"seed\")\n    total_before = sum(r.amount for r in db.transactions.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", src, dst, amount, date)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[0] == [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"]\n    assert len(rows) == 3\n    out_row, in_row = rows[1], rows[2]\n    assert int(in_row[0]) == int(out_row[0]) + 1\n    assert out_row[1] == date and in_row[1] == date\n    assert out_row[2] == src and in_row[2] == dst\n    assert out_row[3] == \"TRANSFER\" and in_row[3] == \"TRANSFER\"\n    assert Decimal(out_row[4]) == Decimal(-cents) / 100\n    assert Decimal(in_row[4]) == Decimal(cents) / 100\n    first = db.transactions.get(txn_id=int(out_row[0]))\n    second = db.transactions.get(txn_id=int(in_row[0]))\n    assert first is not None and second is not None\n    assert first.account == src and first.amount == -cents\n    assert second.account == dst and second.amount == cents\n    assert first.category == \"TRANSFER\" and second.category == \"TRANSFER\"\n    assert sum(r.amount for r in db.transactions.list(account=src)) == 10000 - cents\n    assert sum(r.amount for r in db.transactions.list(account=dst)) == cents\n    assert sum(r.amount for r in db.transactions.list()) == total_before\n=== END AC transfer-success ===\n\n=== AC transfer-memo ===\nIntent: The outgoing row memo names the destination and the incoming row memo names the source, as stored and as printed.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nsrc = \"ZZXMA1\"\ndst = \"ZZXMB1\"\nseed_cat = \"ZZXMSEED\"\ndate = \"2026-06-02\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    db.categories.create(category=seed_cat, description=\"Xfer memo seed\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Memo Source\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Memo Dest\")\n    seed_id = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=seed_id, date=date, account=src, category=seed_cat, amount=5000, memo=\"seed\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", src, dst, \"10.00\", date)\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n    rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n    assert rows[1][5] == f\"transfer to {dst}\"\n    assert rows[2][5] == f\"transfer from {src}\"\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=int(rows[1][0])).memo == rows[1][5]\n    assert db.transactions.get(txn_id=int(rows[2][0])).memo == rows[2][5]\n=== END AC transfer-memo ===\n\n=== AC transfer-rejects-invalid ===\nIntent: Non-positive or malformed amounts, equal accounts, unknown accounts and bad dates exit 3 with empty stdout and db_session() as db:\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    db.categories.create(category=seed_cat, description=\"Xfer reject seed\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Reject Source\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Reject Dest\")\n    seed_id = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=seed_id, date=date, account=src, category=seed_cat, amount=100000, memo=\"seed\")\n    cases = [\n        (src, dst, \"0\", date),\n        (src, dst, \"0.00\", date),\n        (src, dst, \"-5.00\", date),\n        (src, dst, \"1.234\", date),\n        (src, dst, \"abc\", date),\n        (src, src, \"5.00\", date),\n        (src, \"ZZXRNONE\", \"5.00\", date),\n        (\"ZZXRNONE\", dst, \"5.00\", date),\n        (src, dst, \"5.00\", \"2026-02-30\"),\n        (src, dst, \"5.00\", \"06/03/2026\"),\n    ]\n    for args in cases:\n        before = len(db.transactions.list())\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", *args)\n        print(args, code, out, err)\n        assert code == 3\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n=== END AC transfer-rejects-invalid ===\n\n=== AC transfer-rejects-overdraft ===\nIntent: A transfer exceeding the source balance by one cent exits 3 and leaves both balances and the row count unchanged; the exact balance succeeds.\n\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nsrc = \"ZZXOA1\"\ndst = \"ZZXOB1\"\nseed_cat = \"ZZXOSEED\"\ndate = \"2026-06-04\"\nbalance_cents = 20000\nwith db_session() as db:\n    if db.categories.get(category=\"TRANSFER\") is None:\n        db.categories.create(category=\"TRANSFER\", description=\"Internal transfer\")\n    db.categories.create(category=seed_cat, description=\"Xfer overdraft seed\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=src, name=\"Overdraft Source\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=dst, name=\"Overdraft Dest\")\n    seed_id = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=seed_id, date=date, account=src, category=seed_cat, amount=balance_cents, memo=\"seed\")\n    too_much = str(Decimal(balance_cents + 1) / 100)\n    exact = str(Decimal(balance_cents) / 100)\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", src, dst, too_much, date)\n    print(code, out, err)\n    assert code == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n    assert sum(r.amount for r in db.transactions.list(account=src)) == balance_cents\n    assert db.transactions.list(account=dst) == []\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", src, dst, exact, date)\n    print(code, out, err)\n    assert code == 0\n    assert sum(r.amount for r in db.transactions.list(account=src)) == 0\n    assert sum(r.amount for r in db.transactions.list(account=dst)) == balance_cents\n=== END AC transfer-rejects-overdraft ===\n\n=== AC transfer-usage ===\nIntent: A transfer with the wrong argument count exits 2 with empty stdout and writes nothing.\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nwith db_session() as db:\n    before = len(db.transactions.list())\n    for args in [(), (\"A\",), (\"A\", \"B\"), (\"A\", \"B\", \"1.00\"), (\"A\", \"B\", \"1.00\", \"2026-01-01\", \"extra\")]:\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"transfer\", *args)\n        print(args, code, out, err)\n        assert code == 2\n        assert out == \"\"\n    assert len(db.transactions.list()) == before\n=== END AC transfer-usage ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- Every check completes before the first write; a rejected transfer stores neither row.\n- Both rows are written in one database transaction.\n- Amounts are integer cents; no floating point at any layer.\n- Diagnostics go to standard error only; a failing transfer writes nothing to standard output.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-ReportBalances.md ===\n# FEATURE: Report Balances\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261027 V1 |\n| Description | Report each account's transaction count and balance, plus a total row, computed from stored data. |\n| Depends On | FEATURE-LedgerRules.md, FEATURE-LoadTransactions.md, FEATURE-CsvOutput.md |\n| Provides | ledger report balances |\n| Consumes | ledgerlib.rules, ledgerlib.csvout |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\n`ledger report balances` prints one row per account ordered by code, then a `TOTAL` row. It also\ncreates the report dispatcher used by the other reports.\n\n## Trigger\n\nCommand line: `./ledger report balances`. Implemented in `cli/commands/report.py`, which holds a\nreport-name table. An unknown report name, a missing name, or extra arguments is a `UsageError`\n(exit 2) raised before any database access.\n\n## Output\n\nHeader `account,name,transactions,balance`, then per account (ordered by code) the account code,\nname, the count of its transactions, and its balance. Final row `TOTAL,,<count>,<sum>` where\n`<count>` is the total number of stored transactions and `<sum>` the total of all balances.\nMoney is formatted from integer cents with exactly two decimals and never prints as `-0.00`.\nOn an empty ledger the output is the header and `TOTAL,,0,0.00`.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- None — persistence is owned by DATABASE.md.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC balances-report ===\nIntent: Balances rows follow stored accounts in code order with counts and two-decimal balances derived from stored transactions, and a zero balance prints as 0.00.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport re\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nmoney = re.compile(r\"^-?\\d+\\.\\d\\d$\")\nwith db_session() as db:\n    db.categories.create(category=\"ZZRBCAT\", description=\"Rpt Bal\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=\"ZZRB1\", name=\"Rpt One\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=\"ZZRB2\", name=\"Rpt Two\")\n    db.accounts.create(account=\"ZZRB3\", name=\"Rpt Zero\")\n    base = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1\n    specs = [(\"ZZRB1\", 12345), (\"ZZRB1\", -2000), (\"ZZRB2\", 50), (\"ZZRB3\", 700), (\"ZZRB3\", -700)]\n    for i, (acct, cents) in enumerate(specs):\n        db.transactions.create(txn_id=base + i, date=\"2099-01-15\", account=acct, category=\"ZZRBCAT\", amount=cents, memo=\"rb\")\n    code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"balances\")\n    print(out)\n    print(err)\n    assert code == 0\n \"balance\"]\n    accounts = db.accounts.list()\n    txns = db.transactions.list()\n    data, total = rows[1:-1], rows[-1]\n    assert [r[0] for r in data] == [a.account for a in accounts]\n    for r, a in zip(data, accounts):\n        mine = [t.amount for t in txns if t.account == a.account]\n        assert len(r) == 4\n        assert r[1] == a.name\n        assert int(r[2]) == len(mine)\n        assert money.match(r[3])\n        assert Decimal(r[3]) == Decimal(sum(mine)) / 100\n    assert len(total) == 4\n    assert total[0] == \"TOTAL\" and total[1] == \"\"\n    assert int(total[2]) == len(txns)\n    assert money.match(total[3])\n    assert Decimal(total[3]) == Decimal(sum(t.amount for t in txns)) / 100\n    zero = [r for r in data if r[0] == \"ZZRB3\"][0]\n    assert zero[3] == Store\")\n\n    def snapshot():\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(\"report\", \"balances\")\n        print(out, err)\n        assert code == 0\n        rows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\n        mine = [r for r in rows[1:-1] if r[0] == acct][0]\n        return Decimal(mine[3]), int(mine[2]), Decimal(rows[-1][3]), int(rows[-1][2])\n\n    acct_before, count_before, total_before, total_count_before = snapshot()\n    new_id = max([r.txn_id for r in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1\n    db.transactions.create(txn_id=new_id, date=\"2099-02-01\", account=acct, category=\"ZZRBSCAT\", amount=delta, memo=\"rbs\")\n    acct_after, count_after, total_after, total_count_after = snapshot()\n    assert acct_after - acct_before == Decimal(delta) / 100\n    assert count_after == count_before + 1\n    assert total_after - total_before == Decimal(delta) / 100\n    assert total_count_after == total_count_before + 1\n=== END AC balances-computed-from-storage ledger report monthly |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nIntegration story proving the usage-error contract across the whole command table.\n\n## Usage Table\n\nOne shared usage table covers every command and sub-verb; a usage error prints that command's\none-line usage text to standard error.\n\n| Command | Usage |\n|---------|-------|\n| `init` | `ledger init` |\n| `count` | `ledger count` |\n| `load` | `ledger load <accounts\\|categories\\|transactions> <csv>` |\n| `account add` / `get` / `rename` / `delete` | `ledger account add <code> <name>`, `get <code>`, `rename <code> <name>`, `delete <code>` |\n| `txn post` / `get` / `amend` / `delete` | `ledger txn post <account> <category> <amount> <date> [<memo>]`, `get <id>`, `amend <id> <amount>`, `delete <id>` |\n| `transfer` | `ledger transfer <from> <to> <amount> <date>` |\n| `report` | `ledger report <balances\\|categories\\|monthly>` |\n\n## Behavior\n\n- `ledger` with no arguments, an unknown command, unknown table, unknown report, unknown verb, or\n  wrong argument count exits 2.\n- Standard output is empty; standard error carries the usage text.\n- Argument-count checks happen before any database access, so a usage error never reads or writes\n  the database.\n- Invalid values of correct arity (for example a non-digit transaction id) are rejections (exit 3),\n  and absent records are not found (exit 4); neither is a usage error.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- None — persistence is owned by DATABASE.md.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC usage-table ===\nIntent: Every unknown command, table, report, verb and wrong argument count exits 2 with empty stdout, a diagnostic on stderr, and no row changes.\n\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\ncases = [\n    [],\n    [\"frobnicate\"],\n    [\"init\", \"extra\"],\n    [\"count\", \"extra\"],\n    [\"load\"],\n    [\"load\", \"accounts\"],\n    [\"load\", \"nosuch\", \"file.csv\"],\n    [\"load\", \"accounts\", \"file.csv\", \"extra\"],\n    [\"account\"],\n    [\"account\", \"frob\"],\n    [\"account\", \"add\"],\n    [\"account\", \"add\", \"ONLY\"],\n    [\"account\", \"get\"],\n    [\"account\", \"rename\", \"ONLY\"],\n    [\"account\", \"delete\"],\n    [\"txn\"],\n    [\"txn\", \"frob\"],\n    [\"txn\", \"post\", \"A\", \"B\"],\n    [\"txn\", \"get\"],\n    [\"txn\", \"amend\", \"1\"],\n    [\"txn\", \"delete\"],\n    [\"transfer\", \"A\", \"B\", \"1.00\"],\n    [\"report\"],\n    [\"report\", \"nosuch\"],\n    [\"report\", \"balances\", \"extra\"],\n    [\"report\", \"categories\", \"extra\"],\n    [\"report\", \"monthly\", \"extra\"],\n]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    before = (len(db.accounts.list()), len(db.categories.list()), len(db.transactions.list()))\n    for args in cases:\n        code, out, err = cli_runner(*args)\n        print(args, code, repr(out), repr(err))\n        assert code == 2\n        assert out == \"\"\n        assert err.strip() != \"\"\n    after = (len(db.accounts.list()), len(db.categories.list()), len(db.transactions.list()))\n    assert after == before\n=== END AC usage-table ===\n\n=== AC usage-executable ===\nIntent: The ledger executable at the application root exits 2 with empty stdout for no arguments and for an unknown command.\n\nimport subprocess\n\nfor args in ([], [\"frobnicate\"], [\"report\", \"nosuch\"]):\n    result = subprocess.run([\"./ledger\", *args], capture_output=True, text=True)\n    print(args, result.returncode, repr(result.stdout), repr(result.stderr))\n    assert result.returncode == 2\n    assert result.stdout == \"\"\n    assert result.stderr.strip() != \"\"\n=== END AC usage-executable ===\n\n=== AC usage-not-confused-with-rejection ===\nIntent: Correct arity with an invalid value exits 3, and correct arity naming an absent record exits 4, never 2.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"abc\")\nprint(code, out, err)\nassert code == 3\nassert out == \"\"\n\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"get\", \"ZZNOSUCH9\")\nprint(code, out, err)\nassert code == 4\nassert out == \"\"\n\ncode, out, err = cli_runner(\"txn\", \"get\", \"99999999999\")\nprint(code, out, err)\nassert code == 4\nassert out == \"\"\n=== END AC usage-not-confused-with-rejection ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- A usage error never writes to standard output.\n- Usage errors never open or modify the database.\n- Usage
